attack_effect.trigger: Enough distance between triceratops and foe to commit to a charge.

attack_effect.to_hit_rule: +4 attack throw against man-sized or smaller opponents.

habitat.rule: Grassy environments in sub-tropical and temperate regions.

behavior_rules.rule: Although herbivorous, it is very aggressive toward creatures that come near.

population_rules.rule: Female troglodytes fight as hobgoblins, but only to defend the eggs.
Warren has a 33% chance of a shaman and a 25% chance of a witch doctor.
Shaman is statistically equivalent to a sub-chieftain and has Clerical abilities at level 1d4.
Witch doctor is statistically equivalent to a champion and has Mage abilities at level 1d2.

attack_routine.name: weapon_attack
attack_routine.notes: Favored weapons are stone axes, clubs, and great barbed darts treated as javelins with +3 to attack throws.

ability.name: blend_into_environment
ability.effect: Characters encountering troglodytes have a -2 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: stench
ability.trigger: Humans and demi-humans come near a troglodyte.

ability.name: champion
ability.effect: Champion has AC5, 3 Hit Dice, 16 hit points, and +2 bonus to damage rolls from Strength.

ability.name: sub_chieftain
ability.effect: Sub-chieftain has AC6, 4 Hit Dice, 20 hit points, and +2 bonus to damage rolls.

ability.name: chieftain
ability.effect: Chieftain has AC7, 6 Hit Dice, 28 hit points, and +3 bonus to damage rolls.

behavior_rules.rule: Troglodytes are malicious and warlike and attempt to slay creatures that cross their paths.

population_rules.rule: Village has a 50% chance of a shaman and a 25% chance of a witch doctor.
Shaman is statistically equivalent to a sub-chieftain and has Clerical abilities at level 1d4.
Witch doctor is statistically equivalent to a champion and has Mage abilities at level 1d2.

ability.name: regeneration
ability.effect: Regenerates 3 hit points each round unless damage is from fire or acid.
ability.exception: Cannot be permanently destroyed except by fire or acid.

ability.name: reattach_severed_parts
ability.effect: Lost limbs and body parts attempt to crawl or squirm back to the main body and can be instantly reattached by holding them to the stump.

ability.name: returns_from_zero_hit_points
ability.trigger: Troll reaches 0 or fewer hit points.
ability.effect: Troll continues to regenerate and stands again to fight when it reaches 1 or more hit points.

ability.name: champion
ability.effect: Champion has AC6, 7+3 Hit Dice, and 51 hit points.

ability.name: chieftain
ability.effect: Chieftain has AC8, 10+6 Hit Dice, 63 hit points, and +2 bonus to damage rolls with natural attacks.

ability.name: sub_chieftain_and_bodyguards
ability.effect: Village sub-chieftain and bodyguards have AC7, 8+3 Hit Dice, 45 hit points, and +2 bonus to damage rolls with natural attacks.

habitat.rule: Tends to lurk in dungeons, caverns, ruins, and swamps.

behavior_rules.rule: Generally does not bother with prey smaller than a dwarf.

targeting_constraints.constraint: Only lawful, virtuous maidens may approach unicorns.

ability.name: cure_light_wounds
ability.effect: Can cast cure light wounds by touch of its horn.

ability.name: dimension_door
ability.effect: Can transport itself and its rider, as dimension door, up to 360'.

ability.name: carrying_capacity
ability.effect: Can carry up to 30 stone (300lb) at full movement, or up to 60 stone (600lb) at half movement.

attack_effect.effect: Victim loses two levels of experience.

ability.name: coffin_and_grave_soil_dependency
ability.effect: Must take refuge in a coffin or other sanctum during daylight hours and must slumber on soil from its own grave once per month to maintain vitality.

ability.name: gaseous_form
ability.effect: Can take gaseous form at will.

ability.name: shapechange
ability.effect: Can shapechange at will into either a dire wolf or a giant bat.

ability.name: summon_creatures
ability.effect: When underground can summon 1d10 bat swarms or rat swarms; when above can summon 3d6 wolves or 2d4 dire wolves.

ability.name: charming_gaze
ability.effect: Charm person effect.

ability.name: repelled_by_symbols
ability.effect: Draws back from a lawful holy symbol, mirror, or garlic when presented with confidence.
ability.notes: Garlic causes the vampire to cringe for 1d4 rounds. Holy symbol or mirror causes it to take a position where the item does not impede progress or attack. A lawful holy symbol affects a vampire regardless of ethos in life.

ability.name: holy_water
ability.effect: Holy water inflicts 1d6+1 damage.

ability.name: reduction_to_zero_hit_points
ability.effect: Not destroyed; forced into gaseous form.

ability.name: reformation

procedure.step: Gaseous vampire returns to its coffin.
After resting there for 8 hours, it reforms with full hit points.

ability.exception: If all coffins are broken, the vampire is not destroyed but cannot reform until a minion builds a new coffin.

ability.name: true_destruction

procedure.step: Immersion in running water destroys a vampire in 1 turn.
Sunlight exposure turns a vampire to dust unless it succeeds on a saving throw versus Death each round of exposure.
Stake through the heart plus decapitation destroys a vampire.

ability.exception: If staked without decapitation, the vampire appears to die but can revive if the stake is removed.

ability.name: create_spawn
ability.trigger: Human or humanoid is drained of all life energy by a vampire.
ability.effect: Victim returns as a vampire after 3 days.
ability.notes: Spawn is a slave to the creating vampire and becomes free-willed if the master is killed.

references.notation_reference: Once a person becomes a vampire, he or she is a chaotic undead creature.

behavior_rules.rule: Often trained to hunt giant vermin.
Temperamental and occasionally turn on their masters.

save.on_success: ill and bedridden for 30 days; disease not fatal

habitat.rule: At home in sewers, water-filled caverns, and marshes.

ability.name: echolocation
ability.effect: Can perceive by echolocation out to 60'.
ability.exception: Vision is blocked by silence 15' radius.

ability.name: deafened_or_blinded
ability.effect: Effective AC becomes 1 and suffers a -4 penalty to attack throws.

ability.name: initiative_burst
ability.effect: Automatically has initiative on the first round of combat and gains +1 on the second round.

ability.name: jump
ability.effect: Can jump up to 5'.

attack_effect.damage: 2d4 initial bite; then 2d4 blood-drain damage each round while attached.
attack_effect.effect: Clings to the victim and sucks blood.
attack_effect.termination: Continues until either the victim dies or the weasel is killed.

ability.name: infravision
ability.effect: 30' infravision.

ability.name: keen_smell
ability.effect: Tracks prey by scent.

attack_effect.trigger: Unmodified attack throw of 20 against man-sized or smaller creature.
attack_effect.follow_up: Swallowed creature suffers 1d6 damage each round and drowns after 10 rounds.
attack_effect.termination: Damage stops when either the creature dies or the whale is killed.

limitations.limitation: If swallowed creature has a sharp weapon, it may attack from inside with a -4 attack penalty.
If swallowed creature dies and remains in the belly for 6 turns, it is irrecoverably digested.

treasure_rules.rule: Because killer whales can swallow creatures whole, treasure may be recovered from their bellies even though they have no lair.

attack_effect.trigger: Attack throw at least 4 higher than target value against man-sized or smaller creature, or any unmodified attack throw of 20.
attack_effect.follow_up: Swallowed creature suffers 3d6 damage each round and drowns after 10 rounds.
attack_effect.termination: Damage stops when either the creature dies or the whale is killed.

limitations.limitation: If swallowed creature has a sharp weapon, it may attack from inside with a -4 attack penalty.
If swallowed creature dies and remains in the belly for 6 turns, it is irrecoverably digested.

attack_effect.trigger: Chooses to attack a sea vessel.
attack_effect.effect: Can slam a ship with its head.

reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: When it encounters a sea vessel, it usually (90%) leaves it undisturbed but may decide to attack.

treasure_rules.rule: Because sperm whales can swallow creatures whole, treasure may be recovered from their bellies even though they have no lair.

special_defense.name: limited_harm_sources
special_defense.effect: May only be harmed by magical weapons, spells, and weapons made of silver.

ability.name: create_wight
ability.trigger: Human or demi-human is slain by a wight.
ability.effect: Victim becomes a wight in 1d4 days.

population_rules.rule: When a den is encountered, there is a 50% chance that 1d4 cubs are present.

habitat.rule: Primarily wilderness; may venture into caverns and dungeons.

ability.name: cubs
ability.effect: Wolf cubs may be kept and trained in the same manner as dogs.

population_rules.rule: When a den is encountered, there is a 50% chance that 1d4 cubs are present.

habitat.rule: Normally wooded and mountainous areas; may also venture into caverns and dungeons in search of prey.

ability.name: cubs
ability.effect: Dire wolf cubs may be kept and trained in the same manner as dogs but are more difficult to control.

ability.name: goblin_mounts
ability.effect: Goblins capture cubs to train them as mounts.

attack_effect.follow_up: Characters reduced to level 0 are slain.

immunities.immunity: non-magical weapons of wood, bronze, or iron

ability.name: create_wraith
ability.trigger: Character is slain by a wraith.
ability.effect: Victim becomes a wraith in 24 hours.
ability.notes: New wraith is under the command of the wraith that killed the victim.

references.notation_reference: Appearance as armored or armed silhouette has no effect on AC or combat abilities.

population_rules.rule: When an aerie is encountered, there is a 50% probability that 1d6 eggs or 1d4 young are present.

attack_effect.effect: If both talons hit a creature smaller than the wyvern, the target is grabbed unless it succeeds on a saving throw versus Paralysis.
attack_effect.follow_up: Grabbed creatures of man size or less can be carried off.

references.notation_reference: Uploaded source truncates the sentence following the eggs/young clause; no additional rule beyond presence of eggs or young is preserved here.

targeting_constraints.constraint: Does not move or make attacks.

ability.name: acidic_contact
ability.effect: Destroys leather and wood; deals 1d6 damage to bare flesh.

ability.name: spore_cloud
ability.trigger: Any time yellow mold is contacted.
ability.effect: 50% chance to eject spores into a 10' cube area.

ability.name: fire_damage
ability.effect: Torch deals 1d4 damage per strike; burning oil and magical fire deal normal damage.

ability.name: sunlight
ability.effect: Sunlight renders yellow mold dormant.

ability.name: simple_orders_only
ability.effect: Because zombies lack intelligence, instructions from their creator must be very simple.

ability.name: attack_last
ability.effect: Attack last each round because of clumsy, decomposing limbs.

behavior_rules.rule: Typically used by chaotic mages and clerics to guard locations or valuable treasure.
